page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, each vCPU maps to a dedicated physical core, eliminating hyperthreading resource contention. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs, making this server unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads that require dedicated accelerators.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfr7.24xlarge offers high resource density with dedicated CPU cores and a substantial memory footprint. This makes it highly suitable for memory-intensive workloads that also require predictable, non-shared compute performance. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and memory-bound data processing pipelines.
